meta.title: Zenless Theme
meta.description: Zenless Zone Zero inspired palette, typography and brand chrome for the Harness Web UI.

settings.title: ZZZ Theme
settings.voidDesc: Animated hollow background behind the conversation.
settings.voidToggleDesc: Hides the hollow and pauses its animation.
settings.perfToggleDesc: DPR 1.0, texture 96, 20 fps, tight glow off; DPR and texture apply after a reload.
settings.fontDesc: The inpin hongmengti font used by Zenless Zone Zero does not allow unauthorised redistribution, so this theme ships no font files. If you have installed it yourself, the theme picks it up; otherwise it falls back to Source Han Sans.
settings.fontSansDesc: Skip the custom fonts and always use Source Han Sans.
settings.fontBoldDesc: Use the family name as installed in the system, not the file name.
settings.fontThinDesc: Use the family name as installed in the system, not the file name.
settings.voidSizeDesc: Default diameter of the hollow (240–920 px).
settings.voidSpeedDesc: Flow speed multiplier of the light band (0.3–2.5).
settings.voidZoomDesc: Scale while the mouse is held; below 1 shrinks it (0.5–1.6).
settings.voidFollowDesc: Higher follows the pointer more closely (0.2–3.0).
